objective: Detect weak external angular impulse about the vertical base axis independently of the horizontal-wrench fit.
restriction: Original R10 torque control, known mass/COM; yaw witness complements R20, not an all-direction detector. No plant state, collision labels, force history, training seed or future reference at inference.
observable: Past encoder, link-side spring torque with startup bias correction, nominal inertia row already computed by R10, known grip. Compare 12-sample averaged link angular momentum minus integrated measured joint input at times separated by 32 ms.
bound: 1.05 times maximum absolute normal balance for each of grip-off/on over all normal calibration episodes, not an impact-fitted threshold. Never evaluate a difference across a change of nominal load. Three successive exceedances start, eight quiet clear, as in previous detection conventions.
fresh_robustness: hold genuine independent inputs and independent sensor noise checks separate from past/official tests. A radial force through the base axis has zero yaw moment; table friction and payload inertia errors are not gravity.
